description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

description:
Natural History Specimen
Four Polished Petrified Wood Slices
Fossilized Wood and Mineralized Silica
Approximately 16" x 12" x 11" (Lot Dimensions)
Unsigned
This collection of four polished petrified wood slices showcases the intricate process of permineralization, where organic wood fibers are replaced by minerals over millions of years while retaining the original cellular structure. Each specimen displays distinct annual growth rings and vibrant color variations ranging from deep onyx blacks to warm ochre and cream, typical of ancient coniferous or hardwood species. The faces have been polished to a high luster, revealing crystalline structures and unique geological signatures, while the perimeters retain the rugged, natural texture of fossilized bark.
Professionally polished faces highlighting internal mineral structures and growth patterns
Natural rough-hewn edges providing a stark contrast between raw earth and refined surface
Substantial total weight of 24 pounds suitable for architectural display or specimen collection
Condition:
Very good condition with stable mineral structures. As natural specimens, these pieces exhibit inherent fissures, inclusions, and voids characteristic of the fossilization process. Surfaces are polished to a high gloss with minimal abrasions and the specimens remain structurally sound.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.
Pieces Included:
Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites
Condition:
The lot is in damaged vintage condition as noted and photographed. One insulator has a significant chip loss on the lower body. A second piece shows a distinct crack through the glass dome. The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

Amethyst and Quartz Crystal Geode Lot
Natural Mineral Specimens

Condition:
Very good natural condition. The crystals remain sharp and intact with no significant damage to the points or facets. The exterior rocky matrices are stable and structurally sound. Note the presence of red and purple ink markings on the base and side of the specimens.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Product Overview:
This lot contains a variety of raw and partially polished mineral and rock specimens. Included are different types of stones such as clear and rose quartz, amethyst, tiger's eye, purple agate slice, and other minerals and crystals. The specimens come in various shapes, sizes, and colors ranging from purples, blues, oranges, to browns. The collection includes both rough and slightly tumbled pieces, some showing natural wear and matrix.

Specifications:
- Types of stones: Quartz (clear and rose), Amethyst, Tiger's Eye, Agate (including purple slice), assorted other minerals and crystals
- Condition: Mixed raw and partially polished
- Color spectrum: Purples, blues, oranges, browns, and others
- Weight: Approximately 5 pounds

This collection is offered as-is with a diverse array of mineral and rock specimens.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

This intricate mixed media sculpture by artist John P. Koehler captures a stylized natural scene through a sophisticated combination of organic and artisanal materials. The work features hand-blown glass cattails accented with gold-tone luster and delicate clear glass reeds, all emerging from a base crafted from natural burl wood and polished agate geode slices. description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points

Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. Description:
Add timeless charm and practical organization to your collection or study with this vintage wooden pipe rack and humidor set by Decatur Industries. The set includes a beautifully crafted woodgrain rack with space for up to six pipes, alongside a classic barrel-shaped humidor designed to keep your tobacco fresh. The rich brown wooden construction provides both durability and a handsome display, complemented by a soft felted base with an original Decatur Industries sticker for added vintage appeal. This set also comes with five assorted pipes, featuring a variety of materials such as wood and a distinctive corn cob model, each displaying unique character marks of use. The humidor barrel contains four metal smoking tools, perfect for pipe maintenance. Visible signs of age include scratches and a noticeable split on the humidor's side, as well as typical wear on the pipes, which speaks to its authentic vintage status. Ideal for a thoughtful gift or a distinguished display, this piece offers a blend of function, history, and visual interest for any tobacco enthusiast or collector

Hemingray No. 12, CD 113
Aqua Blue-Green, Vintage Mid-Century

The No. 12 model was a standard utility piece used extensively across North American communication lines. Late 20th Century, 1 Pen with Case
Paradise Pens of Hawaii specializes in writing instruments crafted from native Hawaiian hardwoods, emphasizing the natural beauty of the island's flora. This ballpoint pen is fashioned from Koa wood, a species endemic to the Hawaiian Islands that was historically reserved for Hawaiian monarchs. The warm, chatoyant grain of the Koa is complemented by gold-tone accents, reflecting the brand's commitment to Hawaiian craftsmanship and environmental reforestation projects.
